description: What a worker does with the answers of a destination, by delivery mode (REQ-DLV-003, REQ-CFG-004, section 10.6). One destination, one batch of 3 events (batch_size 3), backoff base 1 ms and ceiling 5 ms, a random source that always answers 0.5. Each answer is the SendResult of one call to the destination (accepted, dropped, failed, reason, retry_after_ms); when the answers are used up the last one repeats. Rules: best_effort makes ONE attempt whatever the answer: accepted events are delivered, dropped events are dropped under the reason of the answer (unspecified when empty), failed events are counted as failed. retry: an answer with failed > 0 and dropped == 0 is a transient failure and the batch is sent AGAIN whole after the backoff (never earlier than retry_after_ms) while attempts < retry_max_attempts; when the limit is reached the failed events are dropped under the reason retry_limit_reached; any other answer ends the batch: its accepted events are delivered and its dropped events are dropped under its reason. attempts is the number of calls to the destination, retries is attempts - 1 for the batch, delivered, dropped and failed are the counters of the destination at the end, dropped_by_reason the reasons of the dropped events, min_elapsed_ms (when present) the least time from the first call to the last.

cases.name: best_effort_delivers
cases.description: One answer that accepts the batch.

cases.name: best_effort_does_not_resend
cases.description: best_effort sends once: a transient failure is lost and counted as failed, whatever the retry settings.

cases.name: retry_delivers_at_once
cases.description: With retry an answer that accepts needs no retry.

cases.name: retry_fails_twice_then_succeeds
cases.description: Two transient failures and then success: one delivery, counted as delivered only at the third answer, with two retries.

cases.name: retry_gives_up_at_the_limit
cases.description: The limit of 3 attempts is reached: the batch is dropped with the reason retry_limit_reached.

cases.name: retry_limit_of_one_is_one_attempt
cases.description: With one attempt the first failure is final.

cases.name: retry_does_not_retry_a_permanent_rejection
cases.description: An answer with dropped events (a permanent rejection, 4xx) is final: no retry, the reason of the answer is kept.

cases.name: retry_honors_the_retry_after_hint
cases.description: A failure with a retry_after_ms of 60 waits at least that long before the second attempt.

cases.name: retry_resends_the_whole_batch_after_a_partial_failure
cases.description: An answer with accepted and failed events makes the whole batch be sent again; delivered counts the accepted events of the answer that ends the batch only (the first accepted event may arrive twice, REQ-DLV-001).

cases.name: retry_after_a_success_nothing_more
cases.description: Answers after the one that ends the batch are never used.
